title: cw task start --plan
description: The plan a new task records. cw also checks rules this schema does not state, such as that each requirement's check_ids name planned checks.

title.description: What the task does, at most 4096 bytes.

kind.description: Only an open substantial task gates commit and push.

coordinator_id.description: The coordinating agent that records acceptances and decisions.

checkpoints.description: Omitted: the before and final adviser checkpoints are required.

required.description: Must be given when checkpoints is.

reason.description: Why the checkpoints are not required.

profile.description: The stages, round caps and budget; lite when omitted.

budget.description: Lowers the profile's budget; it cannot raise it.

max_usd.description: Estimated US dollars the task may spend.

stop_at.description: Share of max_usd at which new work stops, at most the profile's 0.8.

check_ids.description: The planned checks that prove the requirement.

allow_non_execution.description: Whether a stated reason may stand in for the checks.

argv.description: The command, run without a shell.

env_passthrough.description: Names of variables cw would otherwise drop that the check receives; never values.
